Shanghai Municipal Police
Sp. Br. Registry.
No. U. 635
30-12-44
Date 3-1-45

Statement

I, the undersigned MOSZEPAN Grigory Pavlovich, Russian subject
68 years of age, residing at 159/11 Av. Haig, beg to state the
following:

The appartment at 159/11 Av. Haig, of which I am the chief
tenant, was on the 23-12-1944 transferred by me to a Chinese
named Kwang Ching Tse on the condition that all the present
sub-tenants would vacate the premises by the 3rd January, 1945
All sub-tenants were informed of this condition and gave their
consent on condition that they will be paid $250,000 so that
they will be able to pay "key money" for a new room.

But later one of the sub-tenants named M.Zimmermann,
declined to accept $250,000 and instead demanded $600,000 and
later raised the sum to $800,000. This offer being obviously
unreasonable I declined it. After this Zimmerman adopted a
threatening attitude towards me and threatened me that he will
call Japanese who would severely deal with me and also threat
to open the gas and burn the house.

All this created an unhealthy atmosphere in the house as
Zimmermann daily abuses me and threatens me. I am of an old age
and am unable to stand all this, therefore I respectfully request
the Police from aggressive behaviour of M.Zimmermann.

G. Moszepan

Mrs. O.V.Morossoff, residing at 159/2 and Mr.I.F.Tomiloff, re
siding at 69 Rte. Paresse several times witnessed aggressive
behaviour of M.Zimmermann. Tomiloff I. F.
Orlorosoff.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
编号 U. 635
1944年12月30日
日期 1945年1月3日

陈述书

本人，下述签署人 MOSZEPAN Grigory Pavlovich，俄籍，
68岁，住海格路159/11号，谨作如下陈述：

海格路159/11号的公寓，本人系主要承租人，已于1944年12月23日转让给一名叫 Kwang Ching Tse（音译）的华人，条件是所有现有分租客须在1945年1月3日前搬离该处。所有分租客均获知此条件，并同意在获得250,000元付款的条件下搬离，以便他们能够支付新房间的“顶费”。

但后来，一名名为 M.Zimmermann 的分租客拒绝接受250,000元，反而要求600,000元，随后又将金额提高至800,000元。鉴于此报价显然不合理，本人予以拒绝。此后，Zimmermann 对本人采取威胁态度，扬言要叫来日本人严厉对付本人，还威胁要打开煤气烧毁房屋。

这一切在屋内造成了不良氛围，因为 Zimmermann 每日辱骂并威胁本人。本人年事已高，无法承受这一切，因此恳请警方保护本人免受 M.Zimmermann 的侵害行为。

G. Moszepan

住在159/2号的 O.V.Morossoff 女士和住在派勒斯路69号的 I.F.Tomiloff 先生曾多次目睹 M.Zimmermann 的侵害行为。 Tomiloff I. F.
Orlorosoff（原文不清）。
